Resolves #17813

🌿 The front door can no longer be wrong about who is standing behind it, because it stopped keeping its own copy of the list.

**The precondition landed, so this could finally run.** #17813 was gated on `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#186` receiving the institution story first — *"Brain #186 is merged before any Brain roster/night-shift detail is removed from Engine."* That ticket is closed completed, and the Brain README now carries the roster at `## The institution in the Brain` and the night shift below it. Nothing is removed here that the Brain does not already hold.

**The duplicate roster was not merely redundant — it had already drifted.** The Brain's table states its own boundary explicitly: *"Live participation and model embodiments change more often … The README does not freeze either into a second authority."* The engine's table did freeze them, and was wrong at the moment I read it: it listed Vega as *"Fable 5.1 active, Opus 5 planned"* while this PR was authored by that seat running Opus 5. A second copy of a registry does not stay a copy; it becomes a competing claim, and it loses quietly.

**Register, not word-count, decides the retired name.** D#17247 settles it in one line — *"Fleet Manager remains the subsystem and fails outward discovery/architecture tests"* — with `Agent Institution` as category/repo language and the product-brand slot still OPEN. So the count going to zero would have been the wrong target:

| occurrence | register before | disposition |
|---|---|---|
| hero film block, poster `alt` + caption (`▶ Watch Neo.mjs — Agent Fleet Manager`) | outward product brand | **removed**, block and all. The YouTube destination still carries the retired title, so per the ticket's fallback it is omitted rather than relabelled |
| repo-map row: *"the Fleet Manager and operator-facing application"* | outward product brand | rewritten to **Agent Institution**, the repo/category language D#17247 authorises |
| repo-map row, subsystem clause | — | *"the Fleet Manager is its first subsystem"* — kept, and now explicit |
| Agent Harness roadmap: *"fleet manager first"* | ambiguous, read as brand | *"the Fleet Manager subsystem first"* — kept, register made explicit |

Two occurrences remain and both are deliberate: AC-3 asks that outward product-name occurrences be zero **and** that internal fleet vocabulary survive where it names the subsystem. A sweep to zero would have deleted the thing D#17247 explicitly preserved.

**The orphan the hero block left behind.** `resources/images/readme/neo-agent-fleet-manager-poster.jpg` (296 KiB) existed only for the removed block — `git grep` finds it nowhere else in live source, only in the mirrored issue corpus quoting the PR that added it. Removed with the block that owned it. Flagging it because it is the one file in this diff the ticket's Fix list does not name; object and I will restore it.

Evidence: L1 (both repository trees read at exact heads — engine `f54fa39aa1`, `neomjs/neo-agent-brain@dev`) → L1 required (docs-only; this PR makes no runtime claim).

## Deltas from ticket

**The ticket's Fix list does not mention the poster asset.** Removing the block orphans a 296 KiB binary, so I removed it too and named it above rather than leaving it for a later bloat sweep to rediscover. That is an addition to the prescribed scope, not a reinterpretation of it.

**AC-3 is satisfied at two remaining occurrences, not at zero.** Stated explicitly because a reviewer counting the string will find two. The ticket's own text and D#17247 both require exactly that outcome; a zero would be a regression against the naming ruling.
